correctness.rationale: The complete published folding classification yields the full congruence lists through L_5. Direct exhaustive enumeration of all set partitions through six vertices independently reproduces those lists, verifies refinement relations and frequencies, and finds exactly the two claimed nonsurjective intervals. The unique frequency-2 relation separates the central-rest frequency-4 interval from the two side-rest intervals.

originality.rationale: The primary source states a lattice embedding into divisors but not surjectivity or its failure. Exact and semantic searches for the L_5 side-rest examples, missing divisor 2, and a smallest nonsurjectivity counterexample found no equivalent or stronger result; the current and prior private ledgers contain no overlapping claim.

value.rationale: The result gives a sharp smallest counterexample to a natural strengthening of a published structural theorem and completely classifies the obstruction at the first possible size, distinguishing two mirror side-rest congruences from the surjective central-rest congruence of the same frequency.
